comment: Canonical @jfs sanitizer policy — the single source of truth for the
security-critical constants that dom-kit's sanitizeHtml and news-kit's
sanitizeHtmlToFragment / URL guards used to hand-mirror (the mirror
comment drifted once already: MATH was blocked in one kit and not the
other). Each kit carries these values between
regenerates them with `jfs-sanitizer-policy-sync`; the kits' CI runs
the `--check` mode and fails on drift.
blockedTags — tags whose ENTIRE SUBTREE is removed, never unwrapped:
unwrapping <script>/<style> would keep their raw text as visible
content, form controls invite UI redressing, and svg/math open mXSS
namespace confusion. Stored lowercase; per-region templates render the
urlControlChars — strips ALL C0 controls + DEL anywhere in a URL
before scheme checks: browsers drop tab/newline/NUL from a URL before
resolving its scheme, so `java\tscript:` would otherwise slip past a
scheme test, and control characters embedded in an accepted URL must
not survive into the returned value either.
